relationships.subject: Nav1.8
relationships.evidence_quote: Using pharmacological blockade in vivo we demonstrated the involvement of ASIC3 and P2X3 in normal mechanosensation and of Nav1.8 and ASIC3 in cold sensitivity.

relationships.subject: ASIC3
relationships.evidence_quote: Using pharmacological blockade in vivo we demonstrated the involvement of ASIC3 and P2X3 in normal mechanosensation and of Nav1.8 and ASIC3 in cold sensitivity.

key_findings: Geriatric rats show decreased mechanical and cold sensitivity with age-dependent changes in DRG Nav1.8, ASIC3, P2X3 and TRPM8 expression.
Geriatric rats have fewer A-like large neurons and a lower peptidergic to non-peptidergic ratio.
